name: Dreve FotoDent Surgical Guide Resin
short_description:

For manufacturing of dental surgical drill guides for tooth-supported and/or teethridge-supported and surgical invasive application.
Drill guides made from FotoDent® guide are dimensionally stable and biocompatible.
description:
Dreve FotoDent® 1kg Transparent Blue Guide Resin

Indications for Use

Manufacturing dental drill guides for placing dental implants.

Indication: Generative manufacturing of drill guides using 3D printing. This serves the dentist as a guide rail during drilling.

Contraindication

If an acrylic allergy exists, an allergic reaction may occur.

Patient Target Group

Patients with a single-tooth gap, partially and/or completely edentulous upper and/or lower jaw.

 

Process Description

Preparation

  • Alignment of drill guide: vertical supports, connection of supports to a baseplate.
  • During processing of the liquid material, wear personal protective equipment (e.g. suitable gloves, safety goggles).
  • Carefully pour the material into the pre-determined container of the production unit.
  • Remove all bubbles with a cleaned object.

 Processing After Printing

  • Further processing is recommended directly after printing (see steps below).
  • After printing, allow approx. 10 minutes dripping time.

Cleaning

  • Cleaning and post curing including supports and baseplate to avoid warpage.
  • Clean in isopropanol medium (purity ≥97%) in bath. Fill two containers:
  1. Pre-clean with isopropanol for 6 minutes (first container).
  2. Blow out using compressed air (pay attention to holes).
  3. Main cleaning with isopropanol for 6 minutes (second container).
  4. Blow out again using compressed air.

Post-Curing

  • After post-curing, remove supporting structures and base plate.

Material data

Tech Specs
Flexural modulus > 1.700 MPa
Flexular strength ≥ 75 MPa
Elongation at break > 10-15 %
Final hardness > 80-85 Shore D

name: Phrozen Wash Mega S
short_description:
Phrozen MEGA S Washer

Large 3d prints need proper cleaning & curing.
So you’ve got yourself a nice big 3d printer.. you need a good wash & cure process for your resin 3d prints to give you the end results you expect.

The Phrozen Mega S Washer has a large 30L capacity & allows the entire build plate to be washed inside it.
Without touching the model, you can simply place the entire plate & let the washer do everything for you.
No mess, no need to touch the resin.

Once cleaned, the models are ready to be cured.
description:
Without proper washing & curing, prints can easily fail or feel sticky to touch.
The Phrozen Wash Mega S has a simple easy to use interface.

It features 2 speeds, & the gyrators automatically oscillate the rotation direction for optimum cleaning.

This system allows the cleaning fluid to oscillate between directions, thus improving penetration in cavities.

Unwashed resin in cavities is the main reason why parts suddenly crack after a few months.
It is also the main reason why parts sometimes crack during the curing process itself.
Because the unwashed resin heats up, & finally fractures the outer wall.
So always remember to have proper drain holes in any part where resin might get trapped, & then, wash the part properly.

Don’t let your models fail at this crucial stage.
Wash without hassle, with a click of a button.

short_description:
PLA Stonefill is a revolutionary 3D printing material that mimics the texture and feel of stone, without having any stone content in it.
So it is just as easy to print as common PLA.

Great if you want a textured look to your 3d prints without having to do any post processing on the CAD designs.

Perfect for 3d printing projects where concrete, bricks or other textured look is required such as Statues, Vases, D&D terrain, & even Architecture models.

Pair them with our wood, rock & metallic designer filaments to elevate your 3d prints to a whole new level.
description:
Stone PLA Filament — Authentic Stone Texture, Modern Print Performance

Experience a filament designed to replicate the look and feel of real stone.

Our Stone PLA offers a naturally textured looking, mineral-like finish ideal for architects, designers, and makers who want a sculptured look rather than a plastic look.

Despite its striking appearance, it remains easy to print and surprisingly versatile as there are no stone particles added in it.

Hides Layer lines, & creates an illusion of texture without complications.

Matted PLA offers pastel colours, but when it comes to the look of concrete or earthy bricks. matted PLAs are still not close enough.
This is why we offer StoneFill.

Natural Stone Aesthetics

The surface texture closely resembles real stone—whether you’re chasing a smooth marble look or a rugged granite-style finish. Printed parts don’t just look like stone; they have a tactile, grainy feel that elevates any model.

Durable & Reliable

This filament isn’t just about looks. Stone PLA produces strong, wear-resistant parts that outperform standard PLA in rigidity and surface hardness, making it suitable for both display pieces and functional décor.

Eco-Friendly & Low-Odour

Made from PLA, it’s biodegradable, low-odour, and contains no harmful additives—safer for you and friendlier for the environment.

Where Stone PLA Excels

Architectural & Design Models
Perfect for scale models, concept studies, and presentation pieces. The natural texture enhances realism and gives models a premium, tactile quality.

Home Décor & Art Pieces
Create vases, lamp bases, sculptures, plaques, and other display items with a stone-like finish that feels handcrafted. Ideal for artists exploring new material aesthetics.

short_description:
The ultimate closed-loop recycled filament made right here in New Zealand!
This rPLA is made entirely from real 3D prints collected from customers — 100% post-consumer PLA, recovered and reborn.
Failed Benchies, mountains of supports, snapped Baby Yodas, & broken prototypes … all carefully sorted, shredded, melted, filtered, and extruded back into high-quality filament.

Print quality you can trust.
Our “Recycled Red” rPLA Pro delivers a smooth, consistent finish and performs just like premium virgin PLA.
Because it’s genuinely recycled, the exact shade of red may vary slightly between batches.

When you’re tinkering, & don’t care about the colour, you can care for the planet.

You reduce the carbon foot print, reduce wastae, get top quality 100% Recycled PLA filament, & support a cutting edge Kiwi manufacturer with a difference.
So using 100% RPLA is a win-win.

We’re really proud to offer KiwiFil’s New Zealand made sustainably sourced R-PLA Pro filament from KiwiFil.
description:

So the common PLA Pro / PLA+ plastic that would otherwise go to waste is turned into perfectly usable filament.

Sustainability without compromise – this RPLA works as well as filament that is extruded from conventional pellet raw material.

Nothing goes to waste.
Even the spool and box are reused. Their appearance may differ from batch to batch, but the filament quality is always top-tier.

Specs: 1 kg / 1.75 mm diameter (±0.05 mm tolerance)

Since this filament is made from a mix of existing 3d prints, the shades can vary significantly between batches.
For eg, ‘Green’ can be everything from Light Green to Dark Forest green, or Red can be everything from Terracotta to Raspberry Red.
Isn’t that the real fun though..!

Yes it costs more than Esun PLA – And we’ve dropped the price to help with this, but it always will cost more..
This is an initiative – a Movement – and we hope you can support us bringing this much needed change into our 3d printing industry..

name: Colorfabb PLA-LW HT – Choose Your Colour
short_description:
Colorfabb Light Weight High Temp PLA filament reduces weight of printed parts by allowing its density to be adjusted based on printing temperature.

Print 2–3 times more parts compared to regular non expanding materials.

This is the new higher temperature handling version of the prove Colorfabb LW-PLA.

It was originally designed for aeromodelling to make light weight aeroplane & drone hulls.

But it has been very successful as a casting pattern in lost wax style casting processes.

Initially, we used standard PLA for lost wax casting patterns.
But since PLA-LW is lower density, there is less PLA to burn out.
This makes much cleaner patterns & has far reduced ash in the process.

So whether its light weight components for general parts, or metal casting patterns, try PLA LW for your next project.
description:
Colorfabb PLA-LW HT Light Weight PLA filament

The new LW-PLA HT is a foaming PLA with high temperature handling capbility, so you can be in direct the sunlight without risking your parts getting soft.

HT PLA Light Weight is ideal for creating high-performance, low-weight components, enhancing both the efficiency and performance of aeromodelling projects.

Our customer found this material to have excellent burn out capability, making it the perfect choice for lost wax casting patterns to make metal parts using common FDM 3d printers.
PLA-LW allows for 35% less material, so your burn out is that much cleaner thanks to reduced ash.

Thanks to its active foaming technology, it produces exceptionally lightweight and low-density parts.
The density of the material is controlled by increasing or reducing foaming, which is done by controlling the temperature.

Higher the temp = Lower the density.

This advanced material features stable interlayer bonding and allows for precise control over foaming rates and strength by adjusting the printing temperature.

There is a balance between low density & strength – so if your applications require very high strength, then adjust the expansion accordingly.

name: Vibers Sustainably Grown PLA – Pastel Purple
short_description:
Vibers is a revolutionary PLA from Netherlands that is made using Elephant grass which grows on poor quality soiled, & captures 4x CO2 than a forest.

This stops PLA made entirely from sugarcane & corn, which competes with rain forest clearings or agricultural land for food sources.
Elephant grass grows in poor quality soil, & efficiently captures 4x more CO2 than a common forest bush.

Colorfabb in Netherlands then makes wonderful filament using Vibers PLA to give you the same quality & precision you expect from them.
This is a win-win for all. Top quality – sustainability – easy to print – what more can we ask for..!

This PLA has a beautiful earthy terracotta look to it.
The elephant grass formulation is not bright, but a more natural looking pastel colour which instantly gives a more earthy terracotta feel to your products.

This is perhaps the most important product we have ever released into New Zealand, & is a product really close to our hearts.
Please support sustainable 3d printing products, & together, let us reduce our 3d carbon foot print.
description:
The Dutch company Vibers has developed a biobased PLA formulation that includes 10% Elephant grass.

This type of grass grows incredibly efficient and catches 4 times the amount of CO2 per acre compared to a regular European forest.
It’s grown on fallow soil not used for food cultivation and doesn’t need additional irrigation.
What nature provides is enough for this plant to thrive.

Due to the leaves being discarded overtime the soil receives important nutrients and revitalizes the soil.
Once a year the crop is harvested, but only the tops, so the biodiversity remains intact.

We are on a mission to reduce 3d printing footprint & need your support – because only together can we do this.
Yes, this product doesn’t cost the same as virgin PLA – it just can’t.. but please think about supporting eco-friendly 3d printing initiatives so that we can reduce our 3d printing foot print.
– Sincere thanks from the Team @ 3D Printer Store.

name: Colorfabb Varioshore TPU – 55A to 92A
short_description:
ColorFabb’s varioshore TPU is a ground breking flexible filament that allows you print parts from 92A right down to 55A, on almost any direct drive 3d printer.
It achieves this using controlled foaming, so you can get the flex you want without having to own each & every filament of those shore hardnesses.
You can print with shore hardness 92A(unfoamed) to shore 55A (maximum foamed).

This is a 700g roll of foaming filament, which means you actually use less material in comparison to normal TPU & get a larger number of parts with a reduced weight.
description:
Colorfabb Varioshore foaming TPU has a variable shore hardness, reduced weight, density and soft touch.

varioShore TPU allows users to vary the density of the material by adjusting temperature and material throughput (speed & layerheight).

At temperatures between 200 and 250C the materials will start to expand to roughly 1.4-1.6 times its original volume, which reduces the density to 0.7 to 0.9 g/cm³ .

This means the material can be printed at low flow rates (60-70%), to compensate the active foaming, which in return can give you very soft rubbery printed parts.

Between 190-200C the material can be printed without foaming, resulting in different haptics and harder prints similar to standard TPU 90, compared to foamed samples.

You can even control the flow rates across the part to be able to give you varying rubber-like flexibility that is comparable to multijet 3d printing.

Perfect for 3d printing orthotic as well as prosthetics thanks to the natural matte feel.

To avoid all these issues, Phrozen Orthodontic resin enables reliable temperature handling & stiffness for optimum appliance production.

name: Phrozen Heat & Mix – Handsfree resin bottle mixer
short_description:
Why buy our 3D Printing Resin Bottle Mixer with Active Heating

This is a bi-directional mixer – it doesn’t just a roll a bottle like most consumer mixers on the market – it actually wobbles the bottle to shake it without bubbling the resin.

Did you know that many common 3d print failures are related to the resin not being mixed properly or being too cold?

Since most bottles are stored standing upright, it is very common for resin monomers & pigments to settle downward.
So when you then use the resin, it has actually separated. This is why the resin needs to be thoroughly mixed.
Simply shaking the resin bottle is not the best option, because shaking it induces bubbles & causes uneven coagulation of the chemicals.

This bottle roller rotates resin bottles inside a heated chamber to mix the resin thoroughly.
By heating the resin while it is being mixed, the nanoparticles that have settled are able to retake a uniform viscosity.
Resins that are heated are less viscous & print much better than when the resin would be thicker.

This mixer provides a consistent & easy solution to shaking the bottle by hand, as just shaking the bottle heavily can cause the resin to bubble rather than actually mixing correctly.
With our heated resin bottle roller, you will greatly reduce print failures caused by the resin being too cold, particularly in winter.

This mixer is particularly useful if you plan to 3d print high performance industrial engineering resins, wax castable resins, ceramic filled or dental resins.
description:
Suitable for common 250/500/1kg/1l resin bottles.

Offers 40°/ 50° Heating Temperature

Bi-directional – Rolling & Oscillation movement. So it moves the bottle side by side as well as tilts it up & down.

Easy to Operate with simple controls.

Particularly important if you use high viscosity industrial resins, dental resins, casting resins, or ceramic filled resins.

If you are printing in colder climates, this heated resin mixer will reduce issues like layer separation, supports braking off part way, unexplained layer lines, banding patterns when you top up resin, & other related anomalies you may have seen before.

This is an incredibly affordable, simple device, that will save you hundreds of dollars in otherwise failed prints.

So its the perfect choice for Gears, Screws, Cogs, even complex worm wheel assembly parts are fine. That includes Hinges & other loading applications.
It is also ideal for electronics enclosures where the enclosure needs to offer electrical & heat insulation, strength, flame retardance & element resistance including wet or organic aqueous conditions.

This makes it the ideal filament for medical applications like temporary implants, surgical guides, orthodontic reconstruction, maxillofacial surgery & many other use cases including aeronautical & aerospace.

For demanding applications where all else would fail, PEEK is the KING of 3D printer materials.

Strongest 3D Printing plastic available in 3d printing filament form.
Handle up to 250C continuous operating temperature with Short term temperature performance up to 300 deg C.

The most dense semi-crystalline polymer thats 3d printable, yet close enough to aluminium in many applications.

BioMedical material that can be used for the human body, dental implants, joint replacements, the list goes on.

PEEK also has low resonance properties that are comparable to natural fibers such as wood, which is helpful when it comes to vibration & damping control. This reduces screws & fasteners loosening under load out of a peek enclosure.

The flexibility and toughness of Facilan™ Ortho, attributed to its glass transition temperature of -60°C, make it highly durable.

Moreover, it is a biodegradable plastic, meeting compostability standards according to EN13432.

One notable advantage of Facilan™ C8 is its ability to print without visible layers. This means that the printed object will have a smooth and seamless appearance, devoid of any visible lines or layers that are typically seen with other filament types. This makes Facilan™ C8 ideal for printing objects that require a high level of aesthetic finish.

In addition to its superior surface finish, Facilan™ C8 also possesses enhanced strength properties compared to PLA. The filament has good dimensional stability, which means that the printed objects are less prone to warping or shrinking during the printing process. description:
Resin 3d printers make parts so good, you won’t believe they are 3d printed.
In the past, they were small machines & the post processing was manual.
But things have completely turned around, to the point that resin 3d printing is now the preferred option of most 3d printer buyers over FDM 3d printers.

How easy is resin 3d printing now?

  • Print the part in the mega 8K 3d printer.
  • Remove the build plate & put it directly into the matching washer for 5 mins
  • Take out the plate & keep it hanging on the washer to let the part dry off
  • Remove the part off the build plate
  • Put the entire build into the curer – all of it will fit as its purpose built
  • 30 mins curing & you have factory quality parts.

Mega 8K Tech Specs:

  • Build Volume : 330 x 180 x 400mm.
  • XY Resolution : 43 microns.
  • Z Resolution : 10 microns.
  • Pre-Calibrated Building Plate: All Sonic Mega 8K building plates are factory calibrated before they are shipped, which means that all you need to do is take your device out of the box and you’re all set to begin printing!
  • Dual Linear Rail & Ball Screw Design: For an ultra-stable Z-axis, Sonic Mega 8K adopts this specific design so that large and heavy objects can be printed with no wobbling.
  • Full Metal Exterior: Phrozen Sonic Mega 8K is made completely of metal. This strengthens the entire structure, making it stronger, and much more sustainable for long-term usage.
  • Max Print Speed: Up to 400 layers/hour!
  • Slicer Software: ChituBox included.
  • Optical ParaLED: Uniform intensity > 95% surface area.

We’re making Resin 3d printing more affordable for kiwis by slashing prices on 3D Printing Resins as well as LCD 3d printers.
We also have New Zealand’s Biggest range of 3D Printing Resins in stock right here in Auckland, ready to ship or collect.

These machines are extremely sought after world wide & there is often a backlog at the Phrozen factory.

Why we suggest using the matching Wash & Cure unit:

You must ensure all the liquid resin is washed off from the printed part. For this, we recommend using an automated cleaning units as it does this very fast, without you having to clean the part by hand or be exposed to any cleaners.

After the liquid from the surface is cleaned off, the part should be post cured so that it is completely tack free & ready for use.

Without proper curing, prints can easily fail. Don’t let your models fail at this crucial stage.
Cure your models in the chamber and with a click of a button, your models will be properly cured.

Some people believe it is perfectly fine to cure with sunlight.
This is commonly believed in places that have Ozone holes, or are generally hot.

Though sunlight has UV in it, there is very less intensity of 405nm wavelenth UV that is needed to cure 3d prints.
The correct UV wavelength is able to penetrate part surface, sunlight can not.
Sunlight will also heat up your model much more than the UV you would get to polymerise the liquid.
Enough UV to give you a tan or a sun burn, sure. But to cure a 3d print – not really.

Curing in the sun heats up models unevenly, & causes distortion.
A curer rotates as it exposes UV, thereby raising the part temperature evenly.
This rise improves the interlayer adhesion & creates strong components that exhibit the qualities the resin makers expected you to achieve.
But heat up parts the wrong way & they will crack.

A poorly cured part is not a safe practice – you don’t want these monomers floating everywhere long term.
Curing 3d printed parts correctly is important for safety so that things are not contaminated.
People are safe to touch them without gloves when parts are fully cured.
